license_required.quote: No person shall practice podiatry unless he shall have been first licensed and registered so to do in the manner provided in this Article

issuing_authority.value: North Carolina State Board of Podiatry Examiners
issuing_authority.quote: North Carolina State Board of Podiatry Examiners, in accordance with Chapter 150B (Administrative Procedure Act) of the General Statutes

moral_character_required.quote: proof that the applicant is of good moral character

degree_required.value: graduate of a college of podiatric medicine accredited by the National Council on Education of the American Podiatry Association
degree_required.quote: the applicant must be a graduate of a college of podiatric medicine accredited by the National Council on Education of the American Podiatry Association

accrediting_body.value: National Council on Education of the American Podiatry Association
accrediting_body.quote: accredited by the National Council on Education of the American Podiatry Association

required.quote: every applicant, as a prerequisite for licensure under this Article, shall complete one year of clinical residency or other equivalent postgraduate clinical program approved by the North Carolina Board of Podiatry Examiners

duration.quote: shall complete one year of clinical residency or other equivalent postgraduate clinical program

kind.value: clinical residency or equivalent postgraduate clinical program
kind.quote: one year of clinical residency or other equivalent postgraduate clinical program approved by the North Carolina Board of Podiatry Examiners

exams.name: National Board Examination
exams.notes: Must be passed before taking the NC podiatry licensure examination
exams.quote: before taking the North Carolina podiatry licensure examination, shall present evidence to the Board that he has passed the National Board Examination

exams.name: North Carolina podiatry licensure examination
exams.notes: Board may waive written exam for those who passed National Board of Podiatry Examination; may require clinical competency exam
exams.quote: The Board may waive the administration of a written examination prepared by it for all initial applicants who have successfully completed the National Board of Podiatry Examination

interval_years.quote: On or before the first day of July of each year every podiatrist engaged in the practice of podiatry in this State shall transmit to the secretary-treasurer

required.quote: all registered podiatrists then or thereafter licensed in the State of North Carolina shall be required to take annual courses of study in subjects relating to the practice of the profession of podiatry

hours_per_period.quote: The length of study shall be prescribed by the Board but shall not exceed 25 hours in any calendar year

period_years.quote: shall not exceed 25 hours in any calendar year

available.quote: If an applicant for licensure is already licensed in another state to practice podiatry, the Board shall issue a license to practice podiatry to the applicant

requirements.value: Applicant must be currently active and in good standing, have practiced at least 5 years (3 of which in a reciprocating state), hold a valid license in another state, have no pending disciplinary proceedings, and the other state's requirements must be equivalent to or higher than NC's and grant similar reciprocity to NC podiatrists.
requirements.quote: The applicant is currently an active, competent practitioner in good standing; and The applicant has practiced at least five years immediately preceding his or her application with at least three of those five years being in a state that grants similar reciprocity to North Carolina podiatrists

regulatory_model.quote: No person shall practice podiatry unless he shall have been first licensed and registered so to do in the manner provided in this Article

title_protection.quote: Any person who engages in the practice of podiatry unless licensed and registered as hereinabove defined, or who attempts to do so, or who professes to do so, shall be guilty of a Class 1 misdemeanor

scope_protection.quote: No person shall practice podiatry unless he shall have been first licensed and registered so to do in the manner provided in this Article

disciplinary_grounds.description: Fraud, deceit, or misrepresentation in obtaining or attempting to obtain a license or renewal
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Has engaged in any act or acts of fraud, deceit or misrepresentation in obtaining or attempting to obtain a license or the renewal thereof

disciplinary_grounds.description: Chronic or persistent use of alcohol or habit-forming drugs to the extent it impairs ability to practice
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Is a chronic or persistent user of alcohol intoxicants or habit-forming drugs or narcotics to the extent that the same impairs his ability to practice podiatry

disciplinary_grounds.description: Conviction of criminal provisions of this Article or plea of guilty or nolo contendere to charges arising therefrom
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Has been convicted of any of the criminal provisions of this Article or has entered a plea of guilty or nolo contendere to any charge or charges arising therefrom

disciplinary_grounds.description: Conviction of or plea to any felony or misdemeanor involving moral turpitude
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Has been convicted of or entered a plea of guilty or nolo contendere to any felony charge or to any misdemeanor charge involving moral turpitude

disciplinary_grounds.description: Conviction of or plea to any state or federal narcotic or barbiturate law violation
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Has been convicted of or entered a plea of guilty or nolo contendere to any charge of violation of any state or federal narcotic or barbiturate law

disciplinary_grounds.description: Violation of any provision of this Article or board rules, or aiding others in such violations
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Has engaged in any act or practice violative of any of the provisions of this Article or violative of any of the rules and regulations promulgated and adopted by the Board, or has aided, abetted or assisted any other person or entity in the violation of the same

disciplinary_grounds.description: Mental, emotional, or physical unfitness to practice podiatry or disability dangerous to patients
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Is mentally, emotionally, or physically unfit to practice podiatry or is afflicted with such a physical or mental disability as to be deemed dangerous to the health and welfare of his patients

disciplinary_grounds.description: Advertising services in a false, deceptive, or misleading manner
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Has advertised services in a false, deceptive, or misleading manner

disciplinary_grounds.description: Permitting use of name, diploma, or license by another for illegal practice or fraudulent licensure
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Has permitted the use of his name, diploma or license by another person either in the illegal practice of podiatry or in attempting to fraudulently obtain a license to practice podiatry

disciplinary_grounds.description: Immoral conduct that discredits the podiatry profession
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Has engaged in such immoral conduct as to discredit the podiatry profession

disciplinary_grounds.description: Obtaining or attempting to obtain any fee through fraud, misrepresentation, or deceit
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Has obtained or collected or attempted to obtain or collect any fee through fraud, misrepresentation, or deceit

disciplinary_grounds.description: Negligence in the practice of podiatry
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Has been negligent in the practice of podiatry

disciplinary_grounds.description: Not professionally competent in the practice of podiatry
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Is not professionally competent in the practice of podiatry

disciplinary_grounds.description: Fraud, deceit, or misrepresentation upon the public or individuals to acquire or retain patients
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Has practiced any fraud, deceit or misrepresentation upon the public or upon any individual in an effort to acquire or retain any patient or patients

disciplinary_grounds.description: Fraudulent or misleading statements about skill, knowledge, or method of treatment
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Has made fraudulent or misleading statements pertaining to his skill, knowledge, or method of treatment or practice

disciplinary_grounds.description: Fraudulent or misleading acts in the practice of podiatry
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Has committed any fraudulent or misleading acts in the practice of podiatry

disciplinary_grounds.description: Wrongfully or fraudulently holding oneself out as a specialist in any branch of podiatry
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Has wrongfully or fraudulently or falsely held himself out to be or represented himself to be qualified as a specialist in any branch of podiatry

disciplinary_grounds.description: Persistently maintaining unsanitary offices, practices, or techniques
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Has persistently maintained, in the practice of podiatry, unsanitary offices, practices, or techniques

disciplinary_grounds.description: Being a menace to public health by reason of having a serious communicable disease
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Is a menace to the public health by reason of having a serious communicable disease

disciplinary_grounds.description: Distributing any intoxicant, drug, or narcotic for other than a lawful purpose
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Has distributed or caused to be distributed any intoxicant, drug, or narcotic for any other than a lawful purpose

disciplinary_grounds.description: Unprofessional conduct as defined by board rules and regulations
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Has engaged in any unprofessional conduct as the same may be, from time to time, defined by the rules and regulations of the Board

definition_quote.value: Podiatry as defined by this Article is the surgical, medical, or mechanical treatment of all ailments of the human foot and ankle, and their related soft tissue structures to the level of the myotendinous junction.
definition_quote.quote: Podiatry as defined by this Article is the surgical, medical, or mechanical treatment of all ailments of the human foot and ankle, and their related soft tissue structures to the level of the myotendinous junction.

methods_authorized.quote: the surgical, medical, or mechanical treatment of all ailments of the human foot and ankle

anatomical_scope_upper_boundary.quote: the surgical, medical, or mechanical treatment of all ailments of the human foot and ankle, and their related soft tissue structures to the level of the myotendinous junction

amputation_authorized.quote: Excluded from the definition of podiatry is the amputation of the entire foot

anesthesia_authority.quote: Excluded from the definition of podiatry is the amputation of the entire foot, the administration of an anesthetic other than local

ankle_surgery_authorized.quote: any surgery on the ankle or on the soft tissue structures related to the ankle, any amputations, and any surgical correction of clubfoot shall be performed by a podiatrist only in a hospital licensed under Article 5 of Chapter 131E

ankle_surgery_facility_requirement.quote: shall be performed by a podiatrist only in a hospital licensed under Article 5 of Chapter 131E of the General Statutes or in a multispecialty ambulatory surgical facility that is not a licensed office setting, and that is licensed under Part D of Article 6 of Chapter 131E of the General Statutes

clubfoot_surgery_restriction.quote: Excluded from the definition of podiatry is the amputation of the entire foot, the administration of an anesthetic other than local, and the surgical correction of clubfoot of an infant two years of age or less
